input.quote: This Agreement will automatically be renewed for periods of twelve (12) months unless either Party gives six (6) months written notice of its intent to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Both term clauses auto-renew with non-renewal notice windows far beyond the fallback ceiling of 60 days: Base Agreement § 4.0 requires six months (approx. 180 days) notice, and the Attachment § 2.0 requires twelve months' notice to escape a further six-month renewal. Windows longer than 90 days are walk-away territory, so this fails the fallback on a material term. The redline takes the clause to the preferred position: IBM may opt out on 30 days' notice, renewals are 12 months, MSL must send a reminder 60 days before renewal, and any renewal price increase is capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%. MSL's own notice period is left untouched to protect supply continuity.

ops.oldText: unless either Party gives six (6) months written notice of its intent to terminate this Agreement
ops.newText: unless IBM gives 30 days' written notice, or MSL gives six (6) months written notice, of its intent to terminate this Agreement

ops.oldText: will automatically be renewed for periods of six (6) months unless either party gives twelve (12) months written notice of its intent to terminate this Agreement
ops.newText: will automatically be renewed for periods of twelve (12) months unless IBM gives 30 days' written notice, or MSL gives twelve (12) months written notice, of its intent to terminate this Agreement

ops.text: MSL shall notify IBM in writing not less than 60 days before the end of the then-current term of the upcoming renewal, and any price increase for a renewal period shall not exceed the lesser of CPI and 3%.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cut IBM's non-renewal notice to 30 days and set the Attachment renewal term to 12 months, leaving MSL's own notice period unchanged so supply continuity is preserved, and added a 60-day renewal reminder from MSL plus a renewal price cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
proposal.summary: 30-day IBM opt-out, 12-month renewals, 60-day MSL reminder, renewal uplift capped at lesser of CPI and 3%

mappings.element: Renewal only by mutual written agreement, unless the automatic-renewal alternative is complete.
For automatic renewal, Customer opt-out on 30 days' notice.
For automatic renewal, Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal.
For renewal price increases, cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
